In this work, we introduce the H2A principle, focusing on the helpfulness, harmlessness, and autonomy of LLMs in tool-use scenarios. To align LLMs with this principle, we present a dataset, ToolAlign, which includes instruction-tuning data and preference data for tool learning, and then train ToolLLaMA on ToolAlign through fine-tuning and preference learning.
